name: Pipedrive
description: A CRM and sales management platform designed to help sales teams manage leads, track activities, and automate workflows.

evidence.claim: Pipedrive supports OAuth 2.0 and API tokens for authentication.
The API covers the majority of core product functionality and is RESTful.
A free Developer Sandbox Account is available for experimentation.
Pipedrive offers official SDKs for Node.js and PHP.
Webhooks are supported for real-time data updates.

notes: Pipedrive provides a dedicated free Developer Sandbox Account for building and testing integrations. OAuth 2.0 is the required method for marketplace apps, while API tokens are available for personal/private use.
